firstPlayerRule: The group chooses its own method for deciding who starts. Continue clockwise from that player.
clarifications: This refreshed rulebook leaves the choice of starting method to the group. Choosing randomly is one way to use that permission.
Check your edition: the separate 15th Anniversary rulebook instead starts with whoever has visited the most European countries.

The separate eight-page anniversary source was also viewed at pages 1, 4 and 8; the differing instructions are explicitly edition-specific.
